channel.title: SporlyWorks — Science-Backed Mycology & Adaptogens
channel.description: Peer-reviewed functional mushroom research, liquid culture guides, and clinical adaptogen studies.

item.title: Why 90% of Probiotics Fail: The Physics of Gastric Acid Survivability
item.description: An analytical dive into gut microbiome survival dynamics, exploring the biochemical barriers of stomach acid and the physical engineering of dual-capsule delivery systems.

item.title: Psilocybe natalensis vs. Cubensis: Comparative Analysis of Hyphal Growth Rates & Biological Efficiency
item.description: Examine the cellular genetics, contamination resistance, and rapid vegetative mycelial growth of Psilocybe natalensis under laboratory conditions.

item.title: Beyond NGF: The Direct Mechanism of Hericenones in Cognitive Plasticity
item.description: Explore the bio-chemical mechanisms behind Hericium erinaceus, how its active compounds cross the blood-brain barrier, and what clinical research shows about Nerve Growth Factor (NGF) stimulation.

item.title: The Cultivator's Guide to Mold: Trichoderma vs. Cobweb
item.description: A practical guide for home mushroom growers to distinguish between healthy mycelium, normal blue bruising, green mold, and cobweb infestations.
